description: This file defines the ExtensionManager class responsible for managing the compilation of module and application extension files within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for initializing extension lists, authenticating access, and merging extension files while handling override files and filtering.
external_files: php's standard library functions (e.g., dirname, file_get_contents, unlink, mkdir_recursive, fopen, fwrite, fclose)
sugar_fopen function (assumed to be a wrapper for fopen)

classes.name: ExtensionManager
classes.description: A class that provides static methods to manage and compile extension files for modules and applications, including handling authentication, initialization, and file merging.

methods.name: handleAuth
methods.description: Checks if the script is accessed through a valid entry point, terminating execution if not.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes the module list and logger for extension management.

methods.name: compileExtensionFiles
methods.description: Public method that compiles extension files for a specified extension, target filename, with optional filtering and application-only flag.

methods.name: compileApplicationExtensions
methods.description: Merges application extension files for a given extension into a target file, applying filters and skipping certain files.

methods.name: compileModuleExtensions
methods.description: Merges module extension files for all modules, handling override files, into a target file.

methods.name: removePhpTagsFromString
methods.description: Removes PHP tags from a string of PHP code.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be skipped based on filename, directory contents, and filter.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves merged extension contents into a specified path and filename, creating directories if necessary.

methods.name: unlinkFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified extension file if it exists.
